semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: "pharmaceutical ai" involves the application of AI in pharmacology and drug discovery. "AI in biomedicine" also focuses on the application of AI in medical and biological domains, which includes pharmaceuticals.
Both "pharmaceutical ai" and "ai for health" cover applications of AI in improving human health, including through the development and optimization of pharmaceuticals.

parent_domains.justification: Medicine is a broad field that includes pharmacology and the application of AI in drug discovery, falling under the healthcare umbrella.
"Pharmaceutical ai" falls under health AI as it is a specialized application of AI focused on improving health outcomes through pharmaceuticals.
Biomedicine encompasses all medical applications of biological techniques, which include pharmaceutical AI applications.
"Pharmaceutical ai" is a subset of applications within the broader category of medical AI, which encompasses various AI applications in the medical field.

closest_parent_domain.justification: "Health ai" is the closest broader category encompassing the specialized focus of "pharmaceutical ai," as it directly relates to health advancements, including pharmaceuticals.

child_domains.justification: Drug discovery is a direct application and subset of pharmaceutical AI, focusing on the research and development aspects within the field.

closest_child_domain.justification: Drug discovery is the most specific domain under pharmaceutical AI, as it directly involves using AI to discover new drugs, which is a core aspect of pharmaceutical AI.

sibling_domains.justification: Both "pharmaceutical ai" and "ai in genomics" are specialized applications of AI within the medical and healthcare domain, focusing on specific areas of biological research that can affect pharmaceuticals.
Similar to "pharmaceutical ai," "machine learning in medicine" involves applying ML techniques to medical fields, including pharmacology.
This domain, like "pharmaceutical ai," uses computational methods in medicine, which includes drug discovery and development processes.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: "Machine learning in medicine" is the closest sibling as it directly pertains to using ML (a subset of AI) techniques in areas like pharmaceuticals, sharing more methods and techniques with pharmaceutical AI.

unrelated_domains.justification: This domain is more broadly focused on societal impacts rather than specific technological applications like pharmaceuticals.
"Creative ai" focuses on creativity and art, which is unrelated to the pharmaceutical industry and its AI applications.
While important, this domain focuses on educational techniques in medicine rather than the pharmaceutical applications of AI.
Although part of healthcare AI, this domain focuses on robotics, which is not directly related to pharmaceutical AI.
